author: The Q
description:
I replaced traditional wheels with a track-like triangular system made from dozens of rollers. To make the mechanism work, I needed a lot of custom parts that had to be precise, strong, and reliable.

That's where the Bambu Lab X2D came in. I used it to 3D print the rollers and other custom components for the mechanism, turning my digital designs into real parts that I could assemble and test.

After putting everything together, there was only one question left - can a bicycle with triangular wheels actually ride?

👉 Check out the Bambu Lab X2D: 
https://tidd.ly/4qpYUOJ

title: Can a Bicycle With TRIANGULAR Wheels Actually Ride?
